areas.name: Campaigns and sending
areas.description: Building and sending emails: editor, templates, personalization tokens, scheduling, A/B tests, send limits.

areas.name: Lead capture, scoring and segmentation
areas.description: Lead scoring models, audience and list segmentation, contact data quality, dedupe.

areas.name: Nurture journeys
areas.description: Automated multi-step programs, triggers, branching, lifecycle stages.

areas.name: CRM sync and integrations
areas.description: Salesforce, HubSpot CRM and Dynamics sync, field mapping, sync errors, APIs, webhooks, other integrations.

areas.name: Attribution and reporting
areas.description: Attribution models, campaign and pipeline reporting, dashboards, exports, analytics.

areas.name: Forms and landing pages
areas.description: Forms, landing pages, progressive profiling, embeds.

areas.name: Consent and privacy
areas.description: Consent capture and records, preference centers, GDPR and CCPA, data residency, retention, DPAs.

areas.name: Deliverability
areas.description: Inbox placement, sender reputation, dedicated IPs, warmup, SPF, DKIM and DMARC, bounces.

areas.name: Security and governance
areas.description: SSO, roles and permissions, audit logs, security reviews and questionnaires, approvals, workspace governance.

areas.name: Pricing and commercial terms
areas.description: Price level, contact tiers and how contacts are counted, packaging, discounts, contract terms, procurement, budget.

areas.name: Migration and implementation
areas.description: Moving from another platform, data and program migration, implementation scope, partners, timelines.

areas.name: Support, onboarding and success
areas.description: Support responsiveness, escalations, onboarding, training, customer success coverage.

areas.name: Platform and usability
areas.description: Performance, reliability, outages, ease of use, and product-wide topics that fit no other area.
